issues.explanation: The section quotes the E1 section title for cross-reference KDJ-AI-2026E2-P06-C44-S06 inside «» marks as «تحلیل داده‌های قضایی», but the cross_references metadata provided with the section gives the full title as «2.2. هوش مصنوعی و تحلیل داده‌های قضایی». The prefix «هوش مصنوعی و» is absent from the verbatim-marked quotation, misrepresenting the E1 section title.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with: (عنوان E1: «هوش مصنوعی و تحلیل داده‌های قضایی»).

issues.explanation: The section cites «بند ۴.۲» as the location in INSO 23683 from which the four data characteristics (حجم، سرعت، گونه، تغییرپذیری) should be drawn for dataset labelling. Evidence item S23683-023 (clause 4.1) is the only evidence covering the four-characteristic big-data selection guide, and separately names clause «4-3» for processing characteristics. No evidence item places the four data characteristics in clause 4.2. Citing clause 4.2 is therefore unsupported and conflicts with the clause 4.1 attribution in the evidence.
issues.quote: بر پایهٔ حجم، سرعت، گونه و تغییرپذیری (بند ۴.۲) برچسب بخورد
issues.suggested_fix: Change «بند ۴.۲» to «بند ۴.۱» to match S23683-023, which places the four-characteristic data guide under clause 4.1. If clause 4.2 cannot be confirmed from available evidence, remove the clause citation entirely.
